title: Eclipse (Aegis Dynamics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Eclipse is a single-seat stealth bomber from Aegis Dynamics in Star Citizen. Its engines are hidden in the hull and its torpedoes ride in an internal bay, so it can sneak up on big ships. The torpedoes use the normal missile controls.

panels.name: Eclipse: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Eclipse's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The Eclipse has two small guns for defending itself. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Torpedo bay (three torpedoes)
controls.text: An internal bay holds three torpedoes, very large missiles meant for big ships. They are launched in missile mode.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button picks the type, as with any missile; the HUD shows the state.

controls.name: Low signature hull (concealed engines)
controls.text: The Eclipse hides its engines inside the hull, which keeps its heat and radar picture small.
controls.context: Being hard to detect lets the ship get close before others see it; switching off systems in the seat panel helps further.
